messages:
maria: Quick question — for the v2 sunset, can we surface a per-tenant 'migration health' in Console so PMs and SREs can see progress? thinking about how routing fallbacks and quota impacts show up.

jon: yep. we sketched a few signals earlier. proposing: version_mismatch_rate, downgrade_handshake_count, and kv_cache_hit_by_version. show percent of requests that requested v2 vs actually served v2.

sasha: prefer calling it 'downgrade_handshake' (explicit when client asked v2 but got v1) — easier to tie to fallback reasons (capacity, timeout, policy).

kevin: +1. UX needs a clear story for quotas: auto-fallbacking customers might suddenly count against legacy quota buckets. we should show "expected quota delta" when a tenant is on fallback.

maria: UX idea: console banner with live counts + a small "simulate fallback" dry-run that runs sampling against real traffic and shows projected quota delta and probability of mismatch. PMs can use to approve rollouts. :bulb:

katie: implementation note: sampling tier: 100% capture for admin tenants and enterprise accounts; 2% for regular tenants to control telemetry costs. Keep sample ids to allow replaying traces.

jon: telemetry schema (sketch):
```
{
  "event":"downgrade_handshake",
  "tenant_id":"T123",
  "requested_version":"v2",
  "served_version":"v1",
  "reason":"capacity_fallback",
  "latency_ms":123,
  "sampled":true
}
```

sasha: also want an alert rule: if downgrade_handshake rate > 0.5% over 10m for any enterprise org => page @oncall. if > 2% for orgs with dedicated capacity, auto open infra ticket.

deploy-bot: roll:deployment: arena-handshake-metrics deployed to prod canary (5% traffic) at 2026-03-19T10:42:00Z :white_check_mark:

kevin: action items: (1) Console banner mock from design + copy, (2) telemetry schema PR + backward-compatible fields, (3) rollout plan with simulated dry-run and quota projection, (4) alerting thresholds + runbook. I'll own the rollout plan.

maria: thanks — I'll loop in PMs, legal (for deprecation notice timing), and support docs. Can someone post a quick short brief we can drop in the weekly eng-planning? :pray:

jon: I'll draft a 2-paragraph brief and ping marketing for a support KB template.

katie: I'll open the telemetry PR with sampling knobs and include a migration of existing metrics to the new names (with aliases).

sasha: I'll work with design on the simulation UI flows and a compact banner that shows key numbers without overwhelming customers.

kevin: cool. will post rollout timeline by EOD tomorrow.
